summary.text: Berlin-based Senior Product Engineer and full-stack developer with 10+ years of experience building and operating production software across healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, and enterprise systems. Strong across React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and PostgreSQL, with end-to-end ownership from technical scoping and architecture through deployment and iteration. At Curalife, defined, architected, and built a HIPAA-compliant telemedicine acquisition product that became one of the company’s primary customer-acquisition and revenue funnels. Recent work includes AI-assisted workflow tools, commerce systems, and integration-heavy product development.
summary.metaDescription: Berlin-based Senior Product Engineer with 10+ years of full-stack experience across React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, integrations, cloud systems, healthcare, fintech, and AI-assisted products.

cartshift.title: Founder & Product Engineer
cartshift.description: Independent product and web development studio focused on production web applications, e-commerce, integrations, and workflow automation.
highlights: Build and ship full-stack web products using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, third-party APIs, and modern cloud tooling.
Develop AI-assisted workflow tools and automations that integrate LLM APIs with external services and operational processes.
Own projects from product definition and technical planning through implementation, deployment, iteration, and maintenance.

curalife.title: Full Stack Developer & R&D Lead
curalife.description: Owned major customer-facing product and platform work across telemedicine and e-commerce, spanning product definition, architecture, frontend, backend, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and production operation.
highlights: Defined, architected, and built Curalife’s HIPAA-compliant telemedicine acquisition product end-to-end, spanning the patient-facing flow, backend logic, external integrations, Google Cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
The telemedicine product became one of Curalife’s primary customer-acquisition and revenue funnels.
Built and evolved customer-facing healthcare and commerce experiences with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Shopify, HubSpot, and third-party APIs.
Led frontend modernization and production workflow improvements with a focus on privacy, reliability, and maintainability.
